framework: MP-SPDZ 0.4.4 (release tarball, sha256 73d64735...), replicated secret sharing over Z_2^128, 3 parties (Scripts/ring.sh), semi-honest honest majority
machine: one laptop (8 logical cores), WSL2 Ubuntu, all three parties on localhost
program: research/mpc/secure_pc.mpc: m = m_a - m_b, C = C_a + C_b (each operator's private in-plane miss offset and covariance), act <=> q + ln det C <= -2 ln(2T/R^2); reveals only the act bit; sfix f=20, k=52
accuracy: act bits identical to the plaintext Pc >= 1e-4 on all 61,000 test encounters (1,000 + 10,000 + 50,000)
